item.text:
**5B.9 Research Note**

Bottom line: mixed, leaning no. The 2024 record shows real stabilization work and some technocratic correction, but also continued inflation/debt stress, heavy reliance on external financing, and a coercive response to public complaints about prices and power cuts. Direct evidence that Sisi personally admitted specific mistakes is limited; that part of the judgment is an inference from IMF/World Bank assessments and the regime’s treatment of economic dissent.

**Evidence for competence / correction**
- [IMF Executive Board Completes the First and Second Reviews of Extended Fund Facility Arrangement for Egypt, Approves Augmentation of the Arrangement](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/03/29/pr24101-egypt-imf-executive-board-completes-first-second-reviews-eff-approves-augmentation) | IMF | 2024-03-29 | The IMF said Egypt was correcting policy slippages through a flexible exchange rate, tighter policy, lower public investment, and a more level playing field for private business; it also noted corrective actions on performance targets. IDs: 5B.9, 5B.7.
- [Arab Republic of Egypt: Third Review Under the Extended Arrangement Under the Extended Fund Facility, Monetary Policy Consultation Clause, Requests for a Waiver of Nonobservance of a Performance Criterion, a Waiver of Applicability of a Performance Criterion, and Modification of Performance Criteria - Supplementary Information](https://www.elibrary.imf.org/view/journals/002/2024/274/article-A002-en.xml) | IMF | 2024-07-24 | The supplement said June inflation had fallen to 27.5% y/y and that authorities expected further moderation absent new shocks. That is evidence of a data-linked policy response, though still mediated through IMF reporting. IDs: 5B.9, 5B.7.
- [IMF Executive Board Completes the Third Review of the Extended Arrangement under the Extended Fund Facility for Egypt](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/07/29/pr24293-egypt-imf-exec-board-completes-3rd-rev-extended-arr-eff) | IMF | 2024-07-29 | The IMF said inflation was easing, FX shortages had been eliminated, fiscal targets were met, debt should keep moving down through consolidation, and social spending should be protected while Gaza and Red Sea disruptions were hurting Suez receipts. IDs: 5B.9, 5B.7, 5B.8.
- [Arab Republic of Egypt: Technical Assistance Report: Public Investment Management Assessment](https://www.imf.org/en/publications/technical-assistance-reports/issues/2024/04/02/arab-republic-of-egypt-technical-assistance-report-public-investment-management-assessment-547051) | IMF | 2024-04-02 | The IMF said Egypt had already taken steps to improve infrastructure access and public investment management through new legislation, information systems, and staff-capacity work, alongside Education 2.0 and health-infrastructure rollout. IDs: 5B.9, 5B.7.

**Evidence against competence / honesty**
- [Macro Poverty Outlook for Arab Republic of Egypt : April 2024](https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099759004052420744) | World Bank | 2024-04-03 | The World Bank said Egypt was using monetary adjustments to address a foreign-currency crisis caused by macro imbalances and global shocks, but growth was still forecast to fall to 2.8% in FY24 because real incomes were being eroded. IDs: 5B.9, 5B.7.
- [Egypt: Halt crackdown on people voicing concerns over economic crisis](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/05/egypt-halt-crackdown-on-people-voicing-concerns-over-economic-crisis/) | Amnesty International | 2024-05-13 | Amnesty documented arrests of people criticizing prices online, questioning of striking workers, and dispersal of a protest blaming Sisi for worsening living standards. This suggests the regime answered economic pain with repression rather than candid correction. IDs: 5B.9, 5B.7.
- [Egypt: More than 100 arbitrarily detained over calls for anti-government protests](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/07/egypt-more-than-100-arbitrarily-detained-over-calls-for-anti-government-protests/) | Amnesty International | 2024-07-18 | Amnesty said 119 people were detained over protest calls linked to price hikes and year-long power cuts, with officials treating complaints about living standards as grounds for imprisonment. IDs: 5B.9, 5B.7.
- [IMF Executive Board Completes the Fourth Review Under the Extended Arrangement Under the Extended Fund Facility and Requests for Modifications of Performance Criteria for Egypt](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/12/24/pr24500-egypt-imf-reaches-sla-on-the-fourth-review-on-the-eff) | IMF | 2024-12-24 | The IMF still said Egypt needed to accelerate divestment, reduce the state footprint, and improve the business environment while creating fiscal space for social programs, which shows the adjustment process was unfinished by year-end. IDs: 5B.9, 5B.7, 5B.8.

Search gap: I found little direct primary evidence of Sisi himself publicly admitting specific economic mistakes or correcting them in plain language. Most of the “competence” evidence comes from IMF/World Bank program assessments, while the clearest “honesty” counterevidence is the arrest of people who complained about prices, wages, and power cuts.
